style: Read this in a clear, upbeat, professional product-demo voice, at a steady pace:

lines.text: The machine never stopped. No alarm went off.
But for two hours, it quietly made scrap.
Defects show up at end-of-shift QC, or at the customer.
Tracing the cause takes hours, and the one expert who knows is on another shift.
For small factories, poor quality can cost up to twenty percent of revenue.
